message:
The build is failing on libselinux due to missing pcre.h. But I only need libsepol and secilc. Let me build just those:

<｜｜DSML｜｜r>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/selinux/libsepol && make -j$(nproc) CFLAGS="-O2 -Wno-error" 2>&1 | tail -20</｜｜DSML｜｜r>
</｜｜DSML｜｜r>
